description: A starter Python app where people browse, add, edit and remove records through a generated web page. Built with FastAPI, and data stays put across refreshes.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. an inventory tracker, a booking system, a task manager - with working persistence
ui.description: Browse, add, edit and remove records from a generated web page, with every record kept between visits. Built with FastAPI.

sample_prompts: An inventory management system for a warehouse with stock tracking
A booking system for a hair salon with appointments and clients
A task manager with projects, assignments, and due dates
